items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
a 1928 bronxville house with a stone wall and a whole perennial garden out front. it's giving storybook!!
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.
5.5 bathrooms for 5 bedrooms. nobody in this house is ever waiting for a shower.
just hit the market this month. 3,400 sq ft in scarsdale for 1.5, honestly kind of a deal for there??
more bathrooms than bedrooms AGAIN. scarsdale has a thing and i respect it.

items.title: "is it better to speak or to die?"
items.body: a super dramatic audio asks that question, and people answer with the thing they'd pick every single time, like spending money or eating. the drama vs. the answer is so dumb and so good.

items.title: "no that doesn't make any sense"
items.body: people lip-sync this with the most confused face while the caption calls out someone doing something the hard way. very relatable.

items.title: "Paper Moon Static" came out of nowhere
items.body: it's the #1 sound on TikTok's worldwide chart today, getting over 100K new videos a DAY. i'd never heard of it before this morning.

items.title: "canon event"
items.body: a big unavoidable life moment that makes you who you are. like your first real heartbreak, or your first terrible boss.

items.title: "beige flag"
items.body: not a red flag, not a green flag. just a weirdly specific quirk, like someone who only drinks room-temp water.

items.title: "NPC"
items.body: someone who acts kind of robotic or bland, like a background character in a video game. kids say it about people with zero personality.

items.title: "rent free"
items.body: when something is living in your head and you can't stop thinking about it.
